observation: A repository scan (431 TSX files: apps that import the design system, plus its own src) found 8 Input elements outside FormField/Field with no aria-label or aria-labelledby. apps/tinyurl/app/routes/tags/tags.tsx:126 is a search field labelled only by its placeholder "Search...", which DESIGN.md (Forms and selection) and the Input contract do not allow. Two hits in apps/img are false positives: a local Control wrapper renders FormField, and the static detector does not follow wrappers. No current rule catches either case.
scope: component.input: every scenario that resolves Input, and check-source runs without a scenario. Not a change to Input itself.

rule.requirement: Every Input and Textarea has a label: an enclosing FormField/Field, or its own aria-label/aria-labelledby. A placeholder is not a label.
rule.source: DESIGN.md Forms and selection: each item has a visible or programmatic label; design/components/input.json content
rule.fix: Wrap the control in FormField with a label, or give a search-style field aria-label (for example aria-label="タグを検索").

decision.reason: Placeholder-only inputs (tinyurl tags search) are unlabeled; accepted as MUST with the known wrapper false positive. Re-based after a formatting-only change invalidated the first proposal.
